credits_text: A film by ROGER A. SCHEICK
other_text: A delusional ride that will leave you speechless. Would it kill you to love her? Inspired by an orgy of blood and murder, just to have what every girl seeks... TRUE LOVE, however. UNRATED. Take a physical and emotional ride through relationship hell. Solied Screen.
moderation_notes: Contains graphic violence, sexual content, and nudity.
